reason: A plugin analysis tool that statically vets installed third-party DSH plugins, reports suspicious patterns and coverage, and offers optional hash-baseline, subprocess logging, and tool-call gating features.

summaries.zh: 对已安装的第三方 DSH 插件进行启发式静态扫描，报告可疑模式、依赖与运行时表面，并提供可选的哈希基线、子进程日志和工具调用门禁。
summaries.en: Heuristically scans installed third-party DSH plugins to report suspicious patterns, dependencies, and runtime surfaces, with optional hash baselines, subprocess logging, and tool-call gating.

capabilities: Reads installed third-party plugin source files and package metadata
Performs heuristic static pattern scans for suspicious behaviors
Counts runtime-related API occurrences and reports scan coverage
Reads and writes an optional content-hash baseline for official packages
Optionally logs suspicious harness subprocess commands
Optionally denies calls to unvetted plugin-provided tools when explicitly configured
